title: A Cultural Escape North of Melbourne
abstract: Bendigo, a town that struck it rich in Australia’s 19th-century gold rush, has other treasures to offer now.

title: Shopping and Eating Amid History in Richmond, Va.
abstract: For years, Church Hill has been a neighborhood to avoid after dark. But these days, the 18th-century enclave has some of the city’s most appealing shops and dining spots.

title: A Hong Kong Street Switches From Ships to (Michelin) Stars
abstract: A stretch of Wanchai, where ships once docked for repairs, is home to trendy dining spots and big-name chefs.
